newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan oil refineries unaffected by weekend quake.
newsitem.headline: Japan oil refineries unaffected by weekend quake.

text.p: Oil refineries located near the epicentre of an earthquake which shook a wide area of central Japan on Sunday were not damaged by the tremor and are operating normally, company spokesmen said on Monday.

The earthquake, which occurred at 2.51 p.m. (0551 GMT) on Sunday, measured 5.6 on the Richter scale with its epicentre in Aichi Prefecture, about 250 km (150 miles) southwest of Tokyo, the Meteorological Agency said.

Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd's Aichi refinery with a capacity of 160,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) and Japan Energy Corp's Chita refinery with a capacity of 95,000 bpd were operating as usual, spokesmen for the companies said.
At least 11 prefectures in the central part of the main island of Honshu felt the earthquake, which shook office buildings in central Tokyo for about 10 seconds.
